title: DNS
concept: The Domain Name System maps human-readable names to the addresses machines route on. It is a hierarchical, distributed database: resolvers walk from the root to top-level domains to authoritative servers, and caching at every layer, bounded by each record's TTL, keeps the system fast at the cost of propagation delay.

posts.title: How we improved DNS record build speed by more than 4,000x
posts.summary: Cloudflare's Zone Builder rebuilt a whole zone whenever a single record changed, which took up to 35 seconds for a zone with a million records. Cloudflare added per-record builds, fed by a Kafka event stream and run by a separate scheduler that locks against full builds. In a million-record test zone, a per-record build took 8 ms or less, against about 34 seconds for a full build.
